svg.title: Ground-anchored retaining wall — Stoðveggur með jarðakkeri
svg.desc: A retaining wall with a footing is tied back by a sloping tendon ending in a thicker embedded bonded anchor zone.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-ground-anchor-wall","label_en":"Ground-anchored retaining wall","label_is":"Stoðveggur með jarðakkeri","section":"04","category_en":"Excavation, foundations and ground engineering","category_is":"Uppgröftur, undirstöður og jarðtækni","batch":2,"tags":["earth-retention","ground-anchor"],"description":"A retaining wall with a footing is tied back by a sloping tendon ending in a thicker embedded bonded anchor zone.","design_note":"A free tendon length and separate thick bonded end distinguish the ground anchor from slender repeated soil nails.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
